# AK-421 -- Configurable CSV delimiter

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | implementation |
| Status | approved (2026-09-23, data tech lead) |
| Work source | request from the EU finance team (spreadsheet locale) |
| Integration owner | data team |
| Prerequisites | none |
| Blocked by | none |

## Goal

`exportCsv` in `src/export/csv.js` always separates fields with a comma.
Add a `delimiter` option, defaulting to `,`, so an export can use `;`.

## Non-goals

- Changing the line terminator or the header.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** -- with `delimiter: ';'` fields are separated by `;`.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-421 AC-1"`
- **AC-2** -- a field containing the configured delimiter is quoted.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-421 AC-2"`

## Allowed changes / write ownership

- `src/export/csv.js`
- `test/export/csv.test.js`

## Generated artifacts, migrations, exported interfaces

None generated, no migration. `exportCsv(fetchPage, options)` gains an
optional option; existing calls are unaffected.
